title: Keep measures distinct from elevations in binary geometry
summary: The measured WKB line used 57 bytes with only the M flag. Both byte orders decoded the original measures 3 and 7 and left elevation absent.

change.description: Choose the WKB ordinate flags and payload from the geometry and the ordinates the writer is configured to emit.

notes: Endianness determines how numbers are encoded, independent of the meaning of the third ordinate.
